$comment: Typora themes vendored into public/themes/. Run `npm run themes:fetch` to sync.
One 'pack' = one upstream source = one directory under public/themes/<pack.slug>/.
Source-relative paths are preserved inside that directory, which is what makes the
themes work untouched: their relative @import and url() references still resolve.
A pack is fetched either from a GitHub repo ('repo' + 'ref') or from a zip ('zip').
Some themes only ship as archives — here the LaTeX theme, whose repository holds
SCSS sources and builds CSS only into releases.
'files' entries ending in '*' are globbed. 'skip' drops paths a glob would otherwise
pull in; @font-face rules pointing at skipped assets are removed automatically, since
leaving them means a 404 the browser tries to parse as a font.
A pack marked 'local' is ours: source committed under public/themes/<slug>/, with no
upstream to reconcile against. It is never downloaded and never deleted, but it is
indexed and reference-checked like every other pack. Local packs are listed first, and
the order of their themes here is the order the picker shows them in.
Every pack carries its own licence file and is credited in the UI. Only packs that
grant redistribution belong here -- Typora's own themes (typora-default-themes, and
Academic from typora-theme-gallery) carry no licence at all, which means all rights
reserved, so they are deliberately not vendored. See THIRD-PARTY.md.
